description:
This workflow demonstrates the usage of the [Community Earth System Model](https://www.cesm.ucar.edu/) on Galaxy Europe. 

A fully coupled B1850 compset with resolution f19_g17 is run for 1 month.

name: Workflow for running the Community Earth System Model in fully coupled mode
